name: The Foothills
intro: The ground tilts. From here the light on the mountain is clearly a window.
outro: Above the treeline. Someone has been camping up here for a very long time.

nodes.label: The First Slope
nodes.text: Switchbacks. Old cairns, stacked by someone with your habits.

nodes.label: Climb
nodes.text: Steady. This is a long day and you are not in a hurry.

nodes.label: Drink Properly
nodes.text: Thin air takes more out of you than the slope does.

nodes.label: Push On
nodes.text: There is more light left than there is fear.

nodes.label: Make Camp Early
nodes.text: Stop while stopping is still a choice.

nodes.label: The Treeline
nodes.text: Above the trees the wind has opinions. The window is closer.
